title: pelargonium auritum var. carneum
intro: Pelargonium auritum var. carneum, commonly known as the 'Cape Geranium', is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional herbal medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pelargonium auritum var. carneum include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it a potential remedy for coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
